objects.name: Detection technique coverage: o365-email-send-and-hard-delete-suspicious-behavior
objects.description: The following analytic identifies when an O365 email account sends and then hard deletes email with within a short period (within 1 hour). This behavior may indicate a compromised account where the threat actor is attempting to remove forensic artifacts or evidence of activity.
